evidence_boundary: This file defines a target design only. Candidate applications, workflows, model/framework replicas, and scale arithmetic are not empirical observations.
objective: Estimate conditional success boundaries, oracle correctness, maintenance effort, cost, latency, and repeatability for visual CUA, hybrid visual-plus-structure agents, and traditional scripted testing without assuming a universal winner.

scale_contract.counting_unit: one arm execution with a complete run record and an independent oracle outcome
counting_exclusions: provider failures without an eligible matched task record
duplicate replays of the same repetition id

current_registry_boundary.rule: Do not report the 30-application target as achieved until each application has a version pin, reset contract, independent oracle, and a passed three-arm admission pilot.

scope_levels.definition: All actions stay on one page of one application.
A persisted or navigational dependency crosses pages within one application.
A value or identity produced in app A is consumed or checked in app B.
At least three applications participate in one intent-preserving workflow.

goal_cardinality.definition: Multiple objectives with an ordered dependency.
A later objective is valid only if an earlier persisted state is correct.

per_application_quota.note: The remaining three workflow slots are allocated after application-specific oracle and mutation review; they must not be filled by near-duplicate tasks.

conditions.purpose: Baseline behavior with no seeded fault or UI change.
A seeded fault changes a persistence, validation, relation, or request outcome while the intent stays fixed.
DOM, accessibility semantics, visual layout, or runtime timing changes while task and oracle semantics stay fixed.

primary_arms.primary_role: visual grounding and coordinate/keyboard action arm
grounded browser-action arm with structural context

primary_arms.locator_policy: accessibility role/name first; CSS/XPath only in a separately labelled ablation

model_replication_strata.pooling_rule: Never pool provider or model strata in the primary estimate. Report model-by-condition interactions and provider failures separately.

minimum_replication_sentinel.formula: 3 applications * 2 workflows * 3 conditions * 2 agent arms * 2 repetitions per model = 72 executions per model before framework replication

agent_framework_strata.rule: A framework is a separate protocol stratum. It can generalize the result only after adapter conformance, replay equivalence, and a matched sentinel pass.

frameworks.status: adapter smoke evidence; matched sentinel pending
adapter smoke evidence; matched sentinel pending
adapter smoke evidence; custom-model matched sentinel pending

admission_gates: version-pinned SUT and deterministic reset digest
reset success and isolation on every counted repetition
independent oracle hidden from all testing arms
clean negative control and seeded-fault positive control
all three primary arms execute the same matched intent and initial state
complete step-level replay record: screenshot or digest, URL, action, model summary, milestone, and timing
provider/framework health failures are classified and excluded from arm-effect denominators
duplicate repetition IDs and cross-cell contamination are rejected
pilot variance is used to freeze repetition count before confirmatory collection

analysis_contract.primary_estimand: conditional arm differences in task completion and oracle correctness under a fixed admitted provider/framework stratum
analysis_contract.reporting_rule: Use conditional decision boundaries and uncertainty intervals; do not rank a single method as globally best unless the preregistered estimand supports that claim.

execution_order: Complete the current-provider matched pilot on the same admitted SUT/workflow before adding applications.
Standardize visual and hybrid step-level run records and replay traces.
Admit applications one at a time after reset/oracle/three-arm gates; expand the named pool from 25 to at least 30.
Run model and framework sentinel replications as labelled strata.
Estimate pilot variance and run power simulation; freeze repetitions.
Collect the 4,320-execution minimum core cohort, then expand to the 30,240-execution confirmatory target if gates remain green.
